name: Madhu
tagline: Eastern-tinged country blues and Americana from the Texas Hill Country.
short_bio: Madhu is a three-piece band from the Texas Hill Country near Austin, playing original songs and classic covers. Their name means “sweet,” and their sound blends an Eastern influence with country blues and Americana — mystical in spirit, true to its Texas roots.
bio: Madhu is a three-piece Texas band from the Hill Country near Austin, playing original material with a mix of classic covers. The band’s name means “sweet,” and their sound blends an Eastern influence with country blues and Americana for a unique sound with a mystical element, while remaining quintessentially true to their Texas roots.

members.name: Mark MacDonald
bio: Mark MacDonald, founder and leader of Madhu, plays acoustic and electric guitars and sings. He has been playing for over 45 years and has been in numerous bands as well as a solo artist. In 2003 he released his first album, “Just a Little Levity,” distributed by The Orchard. His influences include country blues artists such as Robert Johnson, Blind Willie Johnson and Muddy Waters, as well as classic rock artists from the ’60s and ’70s. His first guitar teacher was Michael Knust, the lead guitarist of Fever Tree, under the tutelage of Dale Mullins in Houston, Texas.

Mark was active in the late ’90s and early 2000s around Santa Cruz, California, playing solo and in groups such as Chef of The Future, with whom he opened for Robert Earl Keen and Joe Ely. In Ben Lomond, California, he ran into the late Bob Brozman and was strongly influenced to study slide and country blues, with a focus on the National resonator guitar. Mark also started his own record label in 2000, and recorded and produced two albums for the great blues musician Robert Lowery.

members.name: Christopher Slone
bio: Christopher Slone is a Grammy-winning songwriter from the Chicago area, and holds down the bass guitar for the band. Chris was also active in the Nashville area for many years, and he brings a wealth of musical experience and insight to help shape the band’s sound and arrangements.

members.name: Shoni Dawn
bio: Shoni Dawn has played drums with several bands in the Austin area, most recently PolyFox, an almost-all-girl cover band. She brings a great sense of rhythm and a sensitive feel, with an easy-listening but strong backbeat that accents the mood of Mark’s original material.
